'''Ananda''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ananda}}

== Appearance ==
She was slender with waist-length black hair. 

==Activities==
Ananda was killed during the fighting when [[Siuan Sanche]] was deposed.

== Viewing ==
When [[Min Farshaw]] arrives to Tar Valon to inform the Amyrlin about the Dragon Reborn, she sees Ananda with two other Aes Sedai whose names are not mentioned and she sees ''"A sickly brown halo, shriveled and split by rotting fissures that fell in and widenend as they decayed."''  around Ananda and some other pictures around the other two and she knows that they are going to die. All on the same day.  ''"Blood and skull and halo faded away in the dance of images around the three, came and faded again."'' (''fulfilled'') .{{ref/book|4|1}}
